Set-Cookie.description: Sets the refreshToken cookie: HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, limited to the auth path, Secure unless COOKIE_SECURE=false

post.summary: Logout — revoke the refresh token and clear the cookie
post.description: The refresh cookie itself acts as the credential, so no access token is required. Idempotent: a missing, unknown or already-revoked token also returns 204.

parameters.description: Refresh token cookie set by register, login and refresh; the browser sends it automatically
parameters.name: refreshToken

get.summary: List the visible categories in display order
List posts with optional filtering and pagination
get.description: Public. Without a status filter only published and locked posts are listed. A bearer token is optional and only widens what the status filter may return.

parameters.description: Case-insensitive text search in title and content
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Filter by status. PUBLISHED and LOCKED work for everyone, DELETED for moderators and admins, DRAFT for admins or for your own drafts together with author=<your username>; a status the caller may not see is ignored
parameters.name: status

400.description: Invalid pagination or unsupported sort field

get.description: Public. A draft is visible only to its author and to admins, who need to send their bearer token.

404.description: Not found, deleted, or a draft the caller may not see

403.description: Not the author, or the post is locked
Not the author, the post is locked, or locking requires a moderator

post.summary: Cast a vote on a post or comment
post.description: The first vote on a target answers 201. Voting again in the same direction changes nothing and switching direction moves the score by two; both answer 200 with the caller's vote. Votes are accepted on published posts and visible comments of published posts.

404.description: Post or comment not found, or not readable by the caller

409.description: The post is a draft, or the vote is being changed concurrently

403.description: The vote belongs to another user

409.description: The vote is being changed concurrently

get.summary: List notifications for the authenticated user
get.description: Newest first. With unreadOnly=true only unread notifications are listed; totalElements is then the unread count.

Public. Case-insensitive substring match of the trimmed query. Without a type every kind is searched and paged on its own; with a type only that kind is returned and the others are null. A term that matches nothing returns empty pages.

parameters.description: Search term, 2 to 100 characters after trimming
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Return only this kind of result
parameters.name: type

parameters.description: Page size of each kind, 1 to 50
parameters.name: size

400.description: Query shorter than 2 or longer than 100 characters, unknown type, or invalid pagination
Validation error or wrong current password
